Title: Data Visualization Problem Set
Source_Content: Created by ChatGPT based on common data visualization concepts and best practices.

Problems.Problem_Statement: You have a column salary with 10,000 continuous numeric values and want to see its overall shape (peaks, spread, skew). Best plot?

Answer.Explanation: Histograms are the go-to for visualizing the shape of a single continuous numeric variable — they show peaks, spread, skew, and gaps. Scatterplots need two variables. Countplots are for categorical data. Lineplots are for trends over time.

Problems.Problem_Statement: Same salary column — you want to see the shape AND a smooth curve overlaid on the bars. What do you add?

Answer.Explanation: Adding `kde=True` to `sns.histplot()` overlays a smooth Kernel Density Estimate curve on the histogram bars. This gives you both the bin-based shape and a continuous density estimate in one plot.
